# Storage v2 migration fixture

`storage-v2.zip` was generated by the actual v0.9.0 `run_pipeline(mode="clone")`
with the existing deterministic `FakeSummarizer` and one synthetic Codex chat.
It contains Raw, canonical data, a Thread Note, checkpoints, and valid provenance.
The original chat source is deliberately excluded so migration/resume tests must
work from preserved Raw without reacquiring the original log.

Mutable state paths were anonymized to `C:/example/legacy`; the test loader maps
that prefix to its framework-managed temporary directory. Raw, note, and
provenance bytes are the original synthetic output. No real conversation or
private workspace path is included. This fixture is intentionally versioned by
the old storage contract; do not regenerate it with the new implementation.
